title: Web Foundations
summary: Build a small, well-structured website with HTML and CSS, then publish it online.
outcome: You will finish with a responsive three-page website you can explain and improve.

title: Accessible Interfaces
summary: Make forms, navigation, and common interface patterns easier for more people to use.
outcome: You will audit and improve an interface for keyboard, screen reader, and low-vision users.

title: Everyday Data Skills
summary: Clean a small dataset, answer practical questions, and share what you found clearly.
outcome: You will turn a messy spreadsheet into a short, evidence-based summary.

title: Data Stories
summary: Choose honest charts and combine them into a focused story for a real audience.
outcome: You will create a concise visual report with a clear recommendation.

title: Plan Better Projects
summary: Turn a broad idea into a realistic scope, task list, and simple delivery plan.
outcome: You will leave with a project plan that your team can actually follow.

title: Working in Digital Teams
summary: Use clear handovers, helpful feedback, and version control in a small digital project.
outcome: You will complete a team workflow exercise with a traceable contribution history.
